pop_count: {bubble_shooter_rule_text} The launcher bubble lands at the marked bullseye target. How many existing board bubbles pop, excluding the shot bubble?

drop_count: {bubble_shooter_rule_text} The launcher bubble lands at the marked bullseye target. After that same-color group pops, how many bubbles drop because they are no longer connected to the top?

{bubble_shooter_rule_text} If the launcher bubble lands at the marked target, how many remaining bubbles drop afterward?
{bubble_shooter_rule_text} How many bubbles become disconnected from the top after the launcher bubble causes the pop?
{bubble_shooter_rule_text} Determine the number of bubbles that drop after resolving the shown launcher-bubble shot.
